roles.name: junior-worker
roles.what: works one ticket to closed: writes the code, runs the criteria, starts its reviewer
roles.returns: events on its ticket, which the relay turns into wakes for the session that sent it

roles.name: senior-worker
roles.what: the worker of a ticket graded senior
roles.returns: events on its ticket, which the relay turns into wakes for the session that sent it

roles.name: reviewer
roles.what: reviews one ticket's diff, sending the code-review axes
roles.returns: reviewer.reported on the ticket, which the relay turns into a wake for its worker

roles.name: researcher
roles.what: reads one source, an angle of the code or one kind of evidence, and hands back cited findings
roles.returns: its findings, reported to the session that sent it

roles.name: candidate
roles.what: designs one of several candidate answers to the same brief
roles.returns: its design, reported to the session that sent it

roles.name: advisor
roles.what: a second opinion on one decision, on a stronger model
roles.returns: its answer, reported to the session that sent it
